description:
List purchasable countries

Returns every country whose numbers can currently be bought through the number marketplace. Use the `iso` field of an entry as the `countryIso` argument of the number search and of a purchase. The list is read live from the marketplace and is not paginated. When the marketplace is not enabled for this deployment the endpoint answers 503 instead of an empty list.
name: list_phone_number_countries
title: List purchasable countries
